scope: One fresh local Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster. Two separate in-toto Statement JSON payloads model environment inventory and process/tool execution for the same inert synthetic artifact digest. Each payload is independently DSSE-pre-authenticated and signed with a distinct ephemeral local RSA key; Kubernetes Jobs verify the signatures, payload hashes and expected subject. Counterfactual Jobs reject a corrupted signature and a valid signature whose statement names the wrong subject. A second synthetic build subject has its own valid environment and process pair. This does not exercise or establish coverage of any production CI/CD system, builder identity, key custody, attestation generation, registry storage, or admission enforcement. A scratch additive path runs one real inert transformation Job, restricts evidence writes to a separate collector identity, captures actual Pod/node/image facts, and signs separate environment/process statements for an independent verifier; case-generated signer custody and production pipeline coverage remain adopter evidence.
